description: This file defines an internal singleton object 'DeviceAuthPayload' which provides utility functions to build a version 3 device authentication token string and normalize metadata fields for use in authentication payloads.

methods.name: buildV3
methods.description: Constructs a version 3 device authentication payload string from provided device and metadata information, normalizing certain fields and concatenating all parts with '|' delimiter.

methods.name: normalizeMetadataField
methods.description: Normalizes input metadata strings by trimming, converting uppercase ASCII letters to lowercase, and handling null or empty strings, ensuring deterministic cross-runtime representations.
